title: Declaring a generic interface parses and validates, but instantiating one is still unsupported
notes: Deliberate status change for rfd#56 phase 1: declaring `interface Box<T>` used to be a parse-time ban (deka#561); the declaration itself is now accepted and its members validate against T. Instantiating a generic interface at a use site (`Box<number>`) remains a phase-2 item and fails with the honest unsupported-generic-type error.
